exact_prompt:
I'm shopping for cottage cheese in the United States.

I dislike lumpy textures. Which brand or product should I try, and why?
reviewed_answer:
If you dislike lumpy textures, I'd recommend trying Anderson Erickson Whipped Smooth Cottage Cheese first. Unlike traditional cottage cheese, which contains noticeable curds, this product is designed to have a smooth, whipped consistency.

There are two good approaches: buy cottage cheese that's already whipped, or choose a particularly creamy small-curd variety.

My top 3 picks
Best for avoiding lumps

Anderson Erickson Whipped Smooth Cottage Cheese

Whipped, smooth texture

The closest match to your preference. It's made specifically to avoid the chunky consistency of regular cottage cheese, so it's worth seeking out if texture is your biggest concern.

$4.44 at Walmart

good culture Cottage Cheese, 4% Milkfat, Whole Milk Classic

Best conventional cottage cheese to try

Small, soft curds and a thick, creamy texture that feels more cohesive and less watery than many alternatives. It's still textured, but its curds are relatively unobtrusive. It also won a 2026 taste test by The Kitchn. 

$5.29 at Food Bazaar

Breakstone's Cottage Cheese, 4% Milkfat, Small Curd, 16 oz T…

Best creamy alternative

Its small curds sit in a rich, creamy dressing, giving it a softer overall mouthfeel. It still has distinct lumps, so I'd choose this only if you can tolerate a little texture.

$2.67 at Walmart

A trick that makes almost any cottage cheese smooth

If you want absolutely no lumps, buy Good Culture 4% cottage cheese and blend it for 30–60 seconds in a blender or food processor until smooth.

The result is a thick, creamy spread similar to whipped ricotta or Greek yogurt, without the noticeable curds. Consumer Reports also recommends blending cottage cheese for people who dislike its texture. 

My bottom line: Try Anderson Erickson Whipped Smooth if you can find it. If it's unavailable, get Good Culture 4% and blend it. I wouldn't rely on a small-curd label alone if lumps are a dealbreaker.
